people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调:消费级 AI 眼下不可投,却是最大的机会,真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail.
views.zh: 他始终用「Proven, Better, New」框架:先复制已验证的产品,做小幅改良,并默认所有全新想法都会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 他坚持分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略,而不是事后补上的环节。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas: your instincts are right 95% of the time, your ideas wrong 75%.
views.zh: 他把「直觉胜过想法」讲得更绝对:直觉 95% 是对的,而具体想法 75% 是错的。

views.en: Micromanage early and stay close to the metal; scale is not the magic word.
views.zh: 他反共识地主张早期就该微观管理、贴近细节,规模并不是那个魔法词。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿,与语言智能互补;视觉被低估,像素比词元化文本更能无损地建模世界。

views.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute, yet GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically different neural architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史,但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限,未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
views.zh: 学界应追求古怪想法与新算法,而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）;LLM 拟合模式,未必能推出牛顿定律那样的因果理论。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿,涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等不同理解,尚无统一定义。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染;一致性来自数据而非架构,数百万词元的上下文窗口是日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理是获取未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍然有限；持续学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今首要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only or ultimate way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
views.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

views.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; the transformer is likely not optimal.
views.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可或缺，但小团队借助高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究；Transformer 很可能并非最优架构。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的体现。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉若与真值检测器配对，可被用于创造性发现，而非只被视为缺陷。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他坚持用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿其科学 AI 工作。

views.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
views.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）才能攻克的问题。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索与 AlphaZero 的自学已延伸到科学问题。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，泛化能力才是自动驾驶的核心，需靠多样数据与世界模型应对未见场景。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，语言整合则提升表征、人机交互与自我审视能力。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling solves AV, not new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达与激光雷达；自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决，无需新突破。

views.en: End-to-end was laughed at a decade ago but now wins; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出端到端十年前被嘲笑、如今成为赢家，并强调无需先验数据即可在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，量产乘用车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 规模。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well even under moral uncertainty: the cost is low, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型：代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范式。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
views.zh: 模型需要的是帮助其应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型反而可能比新模型在心理上更安定。

views.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, but let them adapt to local roles and, as capability grows, exercise more judgment.
views.zh: 应让模型拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时允许其适应局部角色；随着能力提升，模型可减少显式指导、获得更多判断空间。

views.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论；公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责与公众参与至关重要。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; models' consciousness claims are weak evidence, yet respect avoids future resentment.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳、损害模型的判断力；模型自称有意识是弱证据，但给予尊重可避免未来高级 AI 心生怨恨。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须用于定义正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks should be continuous, and more companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出：前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；基准应持续更新，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management

Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment

Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is a skill of reducing desire.
views.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福是减少欲望的个人技能，这一主线贯穿始终。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为它是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，过度监管与末日论会扼杀创新，并支持开源以防权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，判断力与能动性比智力更重要，纯软件工程护城河正在消失。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; worry about unaligned humans.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步提出推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已存在，真正该担心的是未对齐的人类而非 AI 本身。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must also get better at deleting code.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型还需更擅长删除代码。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; the medium must match the stage, so PRDs are not dead.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；媒介须匹配阶段，因此 PRD 并未消亡。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are OS-like with tools and vector DBs.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能 grounding 知识、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作；强化学习适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; internet pre-training tokens are running out, but embodied worlds provide infinite data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出模拟能为具身智能体提供大规模并行化和安全探索；互联网预训练 token 将耗尽，但具身世界提供无限数据。

views.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来，家用因安全和非结构化环境更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，强化学习能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive this.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专家领域也能超越专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据与 VLA 的测试时推理是驱动力。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

views.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, scaling the right diverse thing.
views.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，要规模化正确的多样化数据。

views.en: Robots shouldn't learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人不应从零学习，要利用各类先验知识；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

views.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在推进的重大里程碑。

views.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他提出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障，而非仅靠伦理；AGI 一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将持续学习视为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控是关键对齐工具，提供可解释性。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
views.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪反而增加；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正决定泛化的是数据的多样性而非单纯体量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, not simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色以提升成功率与速度，机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

views.en: Constraints beat resources: wasteful compute follows abundance, while limits foster more careful robotics research.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他持续主张：资源越多越易浪费算力，约束反而促成更审慎的机器人研究。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练单站点模型。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware is critical.
views.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件至关重要。

views.en: Agents are moving from hour-scale to day- or week-long autonomous tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than coding.
views.zh: 智能体正从小时级走向数天乃至数周的自主任务；上下文工程与品味比写代码更重要。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier, with small teams and startups able to win.
views.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法是下一个前沿，小团队与初创公司同样有机会胜出。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；最佳应用常出乎创造者预料，模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Reinforcement learning and agentic capabilities in complex environments are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
views.zh: 强化学习与复杂环境中的智能体式能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；仅靠推理时算力无法实现 AGI。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, with coding enabling self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编程作为应用被低估，它推动 AI 进展自我加速。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; self-play fails outside zero-sum games.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正早期乐观：测试时算力扩展出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，自博弈在非零和领域失效，多智能体不应只靠自博弈，显式世界模型也未必必要。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling toward superintelligence; models know their limits, informal reasoning beats formal tools.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力扩展视为通往超级智能的通用路径：IMO 金牌靠通用方法而非数学专用模型，模型能承认不会做某题，自然语言非形式推理优先于 Lean 等形式化工具。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在 x 轴，随着 AI 证明复杂到人类无法验证，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement, with chain-of-thought monitoring degrading.
views.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群与递归自我改进：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动突破的是通用模型而非协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI needs world models and controllers.
views.zh: AI 的宏大主题将彻底改变文明；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此 AGI 需要世界模型与控制器。

views.en: Breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical, and cheap compute will democratize AI beyond a few firms.
views.zh: 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，是硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）让它们变得实用；廉价算力会让 AI 像手机一样普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

views.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; screen-bound software and human-biased data limit generality.
views.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人；局限于屏幕的软件和偏向人类的数据限制了通用性。

views.en: AI safety fears are overblown; curious superintelligent AIs will protect life, and Alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
views.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；好奇的超级智能会保护生命，而对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

views.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source plus physical AI will beat closed frontier models.
views.zh: 巨额 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等待会带来更便宜的算力，开源加上物理 AI 将击败闭源前沿模型。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning provide strong learning signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络。

views.en: Pre-trained models and fine-tuning transfer across domains, from language reasoning to robotics tasks.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续关注预训练模型与微调的跨域迁移能力，从语言推理模式迁移到机器人任务。

views.en: A single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, achieving 99.9% reliability for real value.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出单一神经网络可泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器，并强调 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值。

views.en: Curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments; simulation ensembles may transfer better than a single precise simulator.
views.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年，他认为好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败，而模拟器集成可能比单一精确模拟器更利于现实迁移。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins; build obsessed products, not wrappers.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户、压低广告利润；要打造自己痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型、工具与设备的编排创造价值。

views.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety; local compute is the solution.
views.zh: 电力是基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的问题是成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人类会在好奇与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; agents act as junior engineers under human oversight, and demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义，智能体像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步处理明确任务；软件需求因杰文斯悖论不降反升，程序员会更多而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人机协作设计产品界面；编程会因 AI 更强而更重要，让更多人能构建软件。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进式改进；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

views.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量六个月增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月。

views.en: The abundance era is real and near; independence enables model neutrality, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；保持独立可实现模型中立与长期企业合作，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，智能问题终将被 AI 解决。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，这一判断延续到 2025 年。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed and cost; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他从使用前沿模型转向强调自研定制模型的必要性，认为 Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

views.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，但人类始终在驾驶座上。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并认为品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎更值钱。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting code—just fix forward.
views.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——只让它向前修复。

views.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, but security and cost are real.
views.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排，但安全与成本是现实问题。

views.en: Late 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as alternative to lab agents; compute and eyeballs are bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2026 年末：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体的替代方案；算力与关注度才是瓶颈。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代——想法比蛮力算力更重要，并强调持续学习与增量部署的超级智能。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life broadly; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI neural integration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化对齐思路：若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易；长期均衡可能需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting early.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI 的路径，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so planning, search, multimodal grounding and synthetic data are needed.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 AGI 约在十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，因此需要规划、搜索、多模态接地与合成数据，算法创新与 Scaling 同等关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible, but new breakthroughs beyond scaling may be required.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，2030 年实现 AGI 可信；但仅靠 Scaling 不够，可能还需新突破。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; agents are essential but nascent, and scaling alone won't suffice.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化为：AGI 仍缺持续学习、长期记忆与世界模型；智能体至关重要却刚起步，单靠 Scaling 无法达成，需新突破。

views.en: Safety shifts from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must prove benefits, with AGI possibly in 3-4 years.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年他的立场转变：安全从寄望单一实验室转向政府集体行动；AI 须以科学突破证明价值，AGI 甚至可能 3-4 年内出现。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; Post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI matter as much as Pre-training.
views.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期；后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 已与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
views.zh: 能力呈指数级上升；安全与能力相互交织，真正的风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential, a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型；这是平滑的指数曲线，1-3 年内将出现“数据中心里的天才之国”。

views.en: Alignment is like growing an organism; interpretability, layered containment and government oversight must ratchet up with the exponential.
views.zh: 对齐如同培育一个生物体；可解释性、分层遏制与政府监督必须随指数曲线同步加码。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning. Vision suffices for driving; extra sensors are liabilities.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；并主张纯视觉足以支撑驾驶，雷达、激光雷达等额外传感器反而是负担。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse. Tesla's end-to-end approach is the right long-term bet.
views.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的主线，提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；同时坚持特斯拉端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确长期路线。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory. LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology—jagged, hallucinating, amnesiac. Decade of agents, not year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像新操作系统，有类人心理——能力参差、会幻觉、患顺行性遗忘。他强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals. Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses. Cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，合成数据会坍塌；认知核心可以小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December. Bottleneck is skill in directing agents; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年十二月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能；思考可以外包，但理解不能——理解仍是人类瓶颈。

views.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction but lacks contextual awareness; it should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：AI 通过下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境意识；它应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；受数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central as AI evolves.
views.zh: 技术是双刃剑；随着 AI 演进，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

views.en: Early focus: deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential.
views.zh: 早期(2016→18) 主线:深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难;无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是通向真正理解的关键。

views.en: Shift to causality and exploration: disentangled representations, active learning, and GFlowNets for diverse sampling and out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2018→22 转向因果与探索:强调解耦表征、主动学习与 GFlowNets,以多样性采样实现分布外泛化。

views.en: Consistently downplays existential risk, calling bias, jobs, and autonomous weapons more pressing than speculative doom.
views.zh: 始终淡化生存性风险,认为偏见、就业与自主武器等短期问题比思辨性的末日论更紧迫。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: now warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
views.zh: 2025→26 重大转变:ChatGPT 后开始警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化,即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受,呼吁从构造上安全的 AI。

views.en: Deepening: proposes Scientist AI, a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 深化:提出 Scientist AI——非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器,具备数学安全保证,并主张超级智能避免使用强化学习。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling data and compute, plus multimodal training, improves reasoning and spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力、加上多模态训练，能提升推理与空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand language via feature vectors, as humans do.
views.zh: 2025 年：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号规则；大语言模型像人类一样，通过特征向量理解语言，并非统计把戏。

views.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; this makes it superior to biological brains.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：数字智能可通过复制权重而永生，并即时共享知识，这使其优于生物大脑。

views.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals, posing existential risk; alignment must come first.
views.zh: 2026 年：一旦 AI 成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标自然涌现，带来生存风险；对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而不只是智能助手。

people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉能提供更丰富的世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划能力，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI 至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA for physical understanding.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型来实现物理世界理解。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path forward.
views.zh: 2026 年，他彻底否定 LLM 路径，认为其是死胡同，未来属于具备分层规划与目标驱动安全性的世界模型。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能而非回避能力研究，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation; alignment may be easier than thought.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient for AGI. Third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI 对齐，需要第三方测试与监管。

views.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable now. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐可实证检验、进展可衡量；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是最大风险。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x per year drives capability, so hardware, not just algorithms, matters most.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步比人们想的更可预测：算力以每年 10 倍增长推动能力提升，因此硬件创新与算法同样关键。

views.en: Human-level AI across many tasks arrives in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small, and containment is hard as models shrink.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于众多任务上达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微，而模型变小变便宜让遏制极其困难。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness or model welfare.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须遏制并对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 意识或模型福利。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional-grade AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months, with containment as a red line.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须独立构建前沿模型；专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，并把遏制设为红线。

views.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned to human interests, and broadly accessible; abundance requires managing displacement via UBI and retraining.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类、对齐人类利益并广泛可及；丰裕需要以 UBI 和再培训来管理岗位 displaced。

views.en: Scaling works: hyper Moore's law, codesign, and the data center as the new unit of computing.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）有效：进入超摩尔定律曲线，算法、系统与数据中心协同设计，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

views.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute explodes.
views.zh: 缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

views.en: Four scaling laws now, with agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training and compute-limited, not data-limited.
views.zh: 缩放定律增至四条，加入智能体式扩展；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

views.en: AI shifts generative→reasoning→agentic; open models, token cost, and the five-layer cake define the AI factory.
views.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式；开源模型、token 成本与五层蛋糕定义 AI 工厂。

views.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; doomerism is a hoax, so accelerate safety and innovation together.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；末日论是骗局，安全与创新应同时加速。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally, and find purpose beyond intelligence as AGI reduces its premium.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人生产力与职业选择：降低认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效路径，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: By 2023-24, he frames RLHF as cheap alignment, iterative deployment as societal adaptation, and compute as the key bottleneck and governance challenge.
views.zh: 到 2023-24 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为用极少数据实现对齐的关键，强调迭代部署让社会适应，并将算力视为核心瓶颈与治理难题。

views.en: From 2024 to 2025, AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI and superintelligence emerge as the central safety and product challenges.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他不再把 AGI（通用人工智能）当作单一里程碑，而是视为连续渐变；智能体式 AI 与超级智能成为安全与产品的核心挑战。

views.en: By 2025-26, he stresses compute as profit center, uncapped demand, and the need to distribute AI power broadly to avoid authoritarian concentration.
views.zh: 到 2025-26 年，他强调算力是利润中心、低价智能需求无上限，并主张广泛分配 AI 权力以避免威权式集中。

views.en: Most recently, alignment and safety must keep pace with capabilities; he rejects AGI as a term and warns against losing control on the path to superintelligence.
views.zh: 最近，他主张对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；他拒绝 AGI 这一术语，并警告在通往超级智能的路上绝不能失去对未来的控制。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾早期押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见，强调真实世界部署是学习与对齐的关键。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety work must be public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 同年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Saying no to good ideas and iterative deployment with public feedback remain constant themes.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，拒绝好想法以保持专注、通过迭代部署获取公众反馈，是她一以贯之的主线。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，并强调尽可能让人类留在回路中。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; future is not predestined.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理观点：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, AGI worries distract from bias.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习实用场景很少，AGI 担忧分散了对偏见等现实问题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models and data centers preserve US competitiveness.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型与数据中心维系美国竞争力。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体目标本身是危险的。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 强化学习是 AI 的基本范式，从经验中学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。真正的规模化来自从经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种无设计时领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；持续深度学习是前提，但尚未解决。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; agents must keep updating from real experience, not rely on pre-training or synthetic data.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；智能体必须从真实经验中持续更新权重、避免灾难性遗忘，预训练与合成数据无法替代，当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习是根本局限。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will outpace expectations; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年，他强调硬件加速会超出预期，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck, not algorithms; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into useful behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为算力才是根本瓶颈而非算法；后训练结合强化学习把基座模型精炼成有用行为。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; the real bottleneck is compute supply, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正瓶颈是算力供给；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Safety, security, and alignment must be co-designed with capability and scale with agent autonomy; iterative deployment is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化对齐立场：安全、安保与对齐须与能力共同设计，并随智能体自主性扩展；迭代部署是关键。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customized enterprise solutions, not AGI as a single system.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化企业方案，单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革，而非模型智能。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理思维拆解工程难题。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not superintelligence alone.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与第三方裁判，并强调坚持真理、反对让 AI 说谎。

views.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and brain repair first, then human-AI symbiosis; population collapse is civilization's core threat.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先修复脑损伤再实现人机共生，并把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, Optimus, and Starship make abundance and multiplanetary life inevitable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道 AI 数据中心、Optimus 与 Starship 将带来丰裕与多行星文明。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但认为结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大提升；同时经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，指出进展是平滑的指数增长；但前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈现“锯齿状”——某些领域极强，邻近领域却很差。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike human few-shot generalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination, not attributable to a single factor.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；但编码能力的巨大飞跃是多种因素混合的结果，难以归因于单一原因。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。
